# Your Daily Briefing — Wednesday 19 August

Yesterday was a solid effort — 10km in 53 minutes at an average 156bpm tells a controlled, aerobic story, and 14,679 steps shows you stayed active throughout the day. The 3,178 calories burned gave you a healthy deficit against your 2,300 target, which is exactly where you want to be for that 80-85kg goal.

Recovery looks genuinely good. HRV at 111ms sits comfortably within your 100-118ms baseline, resting HR is an impressive 46bpm, and stress at 30/100 is nice and low. The one flag is 5.7 hours sleep — that's where your recovery debt quietly builds. Go ahead as planned today, but don't skip the warm-up.

Tonight, prioritise getting to bed 45-60 minutes earlier. Sleep is where your 175g protein actually *builds* muscle. Without it, you're leaving adaptation on the table. Lights out by 10pm — make it non-negotiable. 💪
